propositions: New plan reviews must record signed material fingerprints for direct children and prerequisites; material drift in a pinned related ticket invalidates the downstream attestation when enforcement is enabled.

A unified pre-sign transaction collects plan material, phase, and relationship pins once, detects concurrent changes by bracketing collection with equal git HEAD reads, then atomically appends and commits the signed manifest under the global store write lock.

Legacy unpinned attestations remain valid, and older readers verify the stored manifest byte-for-byte including unknown pin lines without reconstructing a filtered manifest, enabling safe backward compatibility.

The fixed plan_review_phase projection (planning or execution) is derived from process_status winning events, bootstrapped from pre-feature snapshots by compiled status, and survives compaction snapshots; execution phase establishes a 0.80 priority-floor requirement.

Close gate enforcement requires both require_plan_review_for_close and enforce_plan_material_pins enabled; it verifies signature, compatible phase, material, and pins but ignores file-dependency hashes and code freshness.

Prerequisite consistency evaluation receives isolated subject and prerequisite plans, returns one deterministic coverage record per canonical prerequisite with disposition consistent/finding/indeterminate, and maps model/parse/attribution failures to unsigned INDETERMINATE records that block certification.
